description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the recent sequence ratio and two metrics—perplexity and GPU memory ratio—evaluated on LLaMA 2-13B and 70B models using an A100 80GB GPU. The x-axis, labeled "Recent Sequence Ratio (%)," uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100. The left y-axis, labeled "Perplexity," is scaled linearly from 4.2 to 4.7, while the right y-axis, labeled "GPU Mem. Ratio (%)," spans from 40 to 100, also on a linear scale. The orange line, representing perplexity, begins at approximately 4.6 at 5% recent sequence ratio, decreases steadily to 4.2 at 40%, remains relatively flat until 80%, and then rises slightly to about 4.3 at 100%. The blue line, representing GPU memory ratio, starts at 40% at 5% and increases linearly to 80% at 100%. Two horizontal reference lines are included: a red dashed line at a perplexity of 4.4 labeled "Full Cache PPL," and a blue dashed line at a GPU memory ratio of 100% labeled "Full Cache GPU Mem." The legend, positioned at the top center, identifies the two data series.
